topSignals.title: Bloom Energy signs 900 MW NTT DATA deal — Bloom's largest fuel-cell agreement outside the US, shipments from 2027.
topSignals.text: NTT DATA (a major Japan-headquartered global IT-services/data-center operator) will deploy Bloom SOFC-based on-site power across its global data center portfolio; no contract value or $/MW figure was disclosed. Bloom shares initially fell as much as ~16% intraday on Nov 5-6 despite the announcement, caught up in a broader post-US-midterm-election sell-off in AI-infrastructure and data-center-power stocks (not Bloom-specific), with at least one bullish sell-side note (Evercore) arguing the addressable market is "deeper than investors thought" even as shares fell further that day; shares partially recovered (reported +2%, alongside AMD +8%) by Nov 9 as the broader AI-stock rout eased. Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway; air-permit hearing remains vacated, no new date set), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational), NEW: NTT DATA (900 MW, global data centers, shipments from 2027 — Bloom's largest deal outside the US; no contract value disclosed).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
